leftEvidence.title: The man hides and answers the LORD God

points.label: What is hidden
points.left: The man and woman hide; the LORD God calls to the man, asks about the tree, and hears the man point to the woman and the woman point to the serpent.
points.right: Inside his final defense, Job uses Adam as a comparison for covering transgression and hiding iniquity in the heart.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Tree, hiding, and judgment · core · Genesis 3:8–13
points.right: Adam in wisdom and reflection · later memory · Job 31:33

payload.posture: The man hides and answers questions after eating is held beside Job asks whether he covered transgression like Adam by hiding wrong in his heart.

rightEvidence.title: Job asks whether he hid wrong like Adam

payload.tension: Job’s brief comparison selects concealment from Adam’s story without retelling the garden scene.
payload.title: Adam’s hiding and Job’s comparison
